additional_info.subject: Mail from ELMS Operator
additional_info.body:
Hi Lukas,
We've been integrating the Siemens Sicharge D360kW NL-SI-E-24-111 with our gateway (Teleport). @Levi mentioned that you might be able to assist with the issue we are currently having. This is a project at Intratuin through Elektropartners (Intratuin Heerhugowaard, Newtonstraat 5). We see that the charger stops following our setpoint/limit as soon as a car connects (state changes from a to c2). I have collected information from a couple of registers before, during, and after a charging session. Prior to the charging session, we set a limit of 24 kW and have not changed anything else (the setpoint is currently written to register 1 every 100 ms).
before charging session:
G_PowerLimit: 24000 (reg 1)
G_FallbackPLim: 9500 (reg 3)
G_Power_Min: 1500 (reg 15)
G_Power_Max: 385450 (reg 16)
G_APower_Present: 210 (reg 17)
G_Power_Limit_active: 24000 (reg 18)
during charging session:
G_PowerLimit: 360000
G_FallbackPLim: 9500
G_Power_Min: 5710
G_Power_Max: 385450
G_APower_Present: 15290
G_Power_Limit_active: 360140
after charging:
G_PowerLimit: 24000
G_FallbackPLim: 9500
G_Power_Min: 1500
G_Power_Max: 385450
G_APower_Present: 190
G_Power_Limit_active: 24000
As you can see, as the car connects, the power limit changes from 24000 to 360000. As soon as the car disconnects, the setpoint of 24 kW is followed again. I do not see how an integration through Modbus could cause this, I suspect it would be some setting of the charger but hopefully, you can tell us more.
Thanks for thinking along!
Best,
Filip Forro
